headline: Midwives Can Now Practice in Alabama but Still Face Obstacles
snippet: First licenses issued January 2019. Nine practitioners allowed out-of-hospital births.

headline: Midwifery bill approved by Alabama House
snippet: Passed 84-11, first time pro-midwife bill reached floor for a vote.

headline: Medical Association strongly opposes decriminalizing Midwives
snippet: AMA strongly opposed. Home birth assistance had been illegal since 2006.
